title: Sr. Observability Systems Engineer
description:
Role Overview

This is a senior individual contributor role with significant architectural ownership. You will set the technical direction for how Backblaze detects, correlates, and responds to infrastructure incidents across our data centers, and you will mentor other engineers on the team as that platform matures. If you have a passion for making complex distributed systems visible, you are comfortable making architecture decisions that will outlive your tenure, and you are excited about applying AI and agentic automation to infrastructure operations, this role was built for you..

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

• Set technical direction and standards for observability across the organization, including instrumentation conventions, alerting philosophy, and dashboard design patterns.

• Mentor engineers on the Observability team and act as a technical resource for SRE, Storage Engineering, and Network Engineering on observability practice.

• Lead design reviews for observability work and represent the team in cross-functional architecture discussions.

• Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions for observability and AIOps tooling, including data sovereignty and compliance considerations.

• Produce and maintain design documentation, runbooks, and architectural decision records that make the platform operable and extensible by future contributors.

Observability Platform

• Own and evolve our metrics pipeline, including VictoriaMetrics, Prometheus, and the Consul-based service discovery layer that keeps scrape targets current as infrastructure scales.

• Own and expand our logging stack (OpenSearch, Logstash, and Filebeat) across all Backblaze data centers.

• Architect and expand distributed tracing with Jaeger and OpenTelemetry, extending coverage beyond the current application instrumentation to new services.

• Define and maintain Grafana dashboard standards for infrastructure, storage, and application performance visibility.

• Drive expansion of internal application telemetry in partnership with application teams to improve visibility.

• Define capacity and retention strategy for the telemetry stack as the fleet grows.

Infrastructure & Automation

• Own infrastructure-as-code for observability stack deployments across multiple Kubernetes clusters.

• Write and review automated playbooks for configuration management and automation across Debian-based bare metal servers.

• Partner with the SRE team on Consul-based service discovery for VictoriaMetrics scrape target automation.

• Lead Ceph storage observability, including OSD health, performance metrics, and integration with alerting.

• Collaborate with the Network Engineering team on BGP, routing, and network-level observability.

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years in a systems engineering, SRE, DevOps, or observability-focused role, including demonstrated technical leadership on a platform or infrastructure team.

• Deep hands-on experience with Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, or equivalent metrics platforms, including PromQL, Alertmanager, and operating these systems at scale.

• Experience designing and operating log aggregation pipelines such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Logstash, Filebeat, or similar.

• Working knowledge of distributed tracing (Jaeger, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent), including instrumentation strategy, not just operation.

• Proficiency in Python and/or Go for automation and tooling.

• Experience with Kubernetes, including deploying workloads and understanding pod networking and storage.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling and configuration management.

• Strong understanding of Linux internals, with Debian/Ubuntu preferred.

• Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar on a team.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You'll work across engineering, SRE, security, and leadership, and you'll be expected to write design documents that drive decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong understanding of:

• Risk Management

• Access Control

• Incident Response

• Privacy Programs

• AI Governance and Risk Management

• Experience interviewing stakeholders and evaluating control effectiveness.

• Excellent report writing, communication, and presentation skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple audit engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

• Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).

• Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Airbyte is the data and action layer for AI agents. We give agents fast, accurate, authenticated access to business data across hundreds of sources, so they can discover the entities that matter, reason over real-time context, and take action in the systems they read from, not just observe them.

We started as the open-source standard for data movement and proved the economics of data integration at scale: hundreds of connectors, thousands of companies, and, since 2020, have raised $181M from leading investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator. As our CEO Michel Tricot puts it, "the last ten years were all about structured data. The future is all about context." We're now building that context infrastructure for production-grade agents on the same open foundation, as agents become the primary consumers of enterprise data.

Our mission is unchanged: make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. That everyone now includes AI agents.

 

THE ROLE:

As Airbyte's Accounting Manager, you’ll own the day-to-day of our accounting operations and reporting - and you’ll help us rebuild how that work gets done, replacing manual processes and outsourced accounting firm dependencies with clean, automated, in-house workflows.

We currently run a lean model with an outsourced accounting firm and a Senior Accountant. You’ll manage both, and over time help us bring accounting back in-house - taking ownership of more of the function as you go. You’ll report directly to the Director of Finance (who reports to the COO) as a thought partner on automating our close and operations, and you’ll have real room to experiment with modern tooling and AI to do it.

We're hiring someone with the intention of investing in their long-term growth. As the business evolves, this role is expected to take on increasing ownership and responsibility, with the opportunity to help shape and ultimately lead the accounting function over time. If you want to build a modern accounting function - not just maintain one - this is that seat.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Own accounting operations and reporting - GL, AP/AR, and the general ledger close - with accuracy, timeliness, and US GAAP compliance; you’ll operate with high ownership and strong judgment.

- Run the month-end close, and continuously shorten and automate it.

- Manage a Senior Accountant and our outsourced accounting team, and help lead the transition of work in-house over time.

- Prepare for and support external audits, including documentation, technical accounting memos, and internal controls.

- Apply and help maintain technical accounting policies, including revenue recognition under ASC 606 and lease accounting under ASC 842.

- Evaluate, implement, and optimize accounting systems and workflows - reducing manual work and building for scale.

- Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Support to keep accounting accurate across our business systems.

- Act as a thought partner to the Director of Finance on automating close and operations, including using AI where it drives real impact.

- Grow into broader ownership of the accounting function as the business scales.

- Perform and review detailed flux and variance analysis, identifying and proactively investigating unexpected trends or anomalies in our financials.

 

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

- 5+ years of progressive accounting experience.

- Ideally a Big 4 audit and startup combined background.

- Working knowledge of US GAAP, including revenue recognition (ASC 606) and lease accounting (ASC 842).

- Strong systems instincts - you’ve evaluated, implemented, or redesigned accounting workflows and tools, and you reach for automation before manual effort.

- Tech-savvy and genuinely AI-curious - you’ve explored (or are eager to explore) how automation and AI can transform accounting, and you like building.

- An operational, ownership mindset - pragmatic, solution-oriented, and able to work autonomo

Description: Turning on a refrigerator remotely requires the boat to be connected. However, boats are often located in archipelagos or remote areas with poor network coverage. This thesis project explores Edge Computing and investigates how logic and system states can be managed locally on the boat while synchronizing intelligently with the cloud.

Research questions:

• How do you design a system (Digital Twin) where a user can send the command "Turn on the AC" from an app, have the command placed in a queue, and execute it automatically as soon as the boat regains network connectivity?

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
Kunai builds full-stack technology solutions for banks, credit and payment networks, infrastructure providers, and their customers. Together, we are changing the world’s relationship with financial services. At Kunai , we help our clients modernize, capitalize on emerging trends, and evolve their business for the coming decades by remaining tech-agnostic and human-centered.

We're building a new abstraction layer that gives applications - regardless of language - safe, consistent access to data living in our core banking system, without those applications ever needing to interact with the core directly. This layer sits between our banking core and every downstream data product and application that consumes its data.
You'll join as a Senior Backend Engineer working primarily in Go. You'll partner closely with our Profile Engineer, who owns the core-side implementation in FIS Profile's proprietary scripting language (PSL), while you build the integration layer that sits in front of it. You won't be writing new product-facing API endpoints - your focus is the layer underneath: data extraction, modeling, and the access patterns that let other teams' applications consume this data safely.
What you'll do

• Design and build Go services that transform data surfaced from our core banking system into a consistent model usable by any downstream application

• Partner with our Profile engineer and data engineers to define clean extraction points from the core - you won't write PSL yourself, but you'll need to understand enough of the data model and business-process mapping to design the right abstraction around it

• Build and maintain the access layer (APIs and/or event streams) that lets other teams integrate with this data without touching the core directly

• Enforce data integrity, access boundaries, and schema versioning so changes in the core don't ripple out to every consuming application

• Integrate with existing API endpoints maintained by other teams - this role extends and consumes APIs, it does not originate new product-facing endpoints

• Help define whether new data products are served via batch, event-driven (e.g. Kafka/CDC), or real-time APIs, depending on freshness requirements

• Collaborate with data engineers on the same team to make new data products viewable/queryable downstream

What we're looking for

• 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with Go as your primary/preferred language

• Experience building integration, abstraction, or platform layers that sit between legacy systems of record and modern consuming applications

• Comfort working with transactional systems and/or payments

• Experience with event-driven architectures like Kafka and CDC pipelines

• Prior exposure to legacy core banking systems is a plus, though we don't expect Go engineers to write Profile/PSL themselves

• Experience provisioning cloud services in AWS or other providers

US Remote · Compensation depends on location but is generally between 140 - 170k base with an up-to 20% annual bonus.

title: Barnläkare för digitalt arbete
description:
Vill du vara med och förändra vården?
Då vill vi prata med dig!
Om den digitala tjänsten
Hej! Jag heter Maria Lundqvist och är verksamhetschef på Kry Digital. Jag tror på en enkel sak: vården blir bättre när vi vågar göra den annorlunda. I vår digitala tjänst jobbar vi nära varandra med hjälp av våra digitala verktyg. Det är lika självklart att be om hjälp som att komma med en ny idé. Vi är ett team på 140 medarbetare som delar samma övertygelse - att hög tillgänglighet, ny teknik och ett genuint fokus på kvalitet och patientnöjdhet inte är motsatser. Det bevisar vi varje dag.

Varför Kry ?
Vi har förändrat hur vård bedrivs i Sverige i över tio år. Gjort den digital, tillgänglig och mer jämlik. Men vi är inte klara och det är poängen.På Kry tror vi att det modigaste du kan göra i vårdbranschen är att vara snäll. Och att de som kan vården ska styra den. Hos oss får du mandat att göra det - ta det, be inte om det.

Vad du faktiskt gör
Du genomför digitala konsultationer via vår plattform och du gör det på ett sätt som får barnpatienter att känna sig sedda. Du kan även komma att avlasta våra vårdcentraler digitalt och journalföra i regionala system. Arbetet är brett. Du utreder, bedömer och behandlar barn upp till 18 år: akuta bedömningar, långsiktig uppföljning, digitalt och fysiskt. Du samarbetar nära vårdcentralerna och övriga vårdflöden. Vi tror inte att digital och fysisk vård är varandras motpoler. De är varandras förutsättningar. Dina erfarenheter är med och formar hur vi arbetar, idag och framåt. Det kallar vi Kry -modellen.Läs mer om den här.

Vad vi förväntar oss av dig

• Specialist i barn- och ungdomsmedicin.

• Meriterande att kunna ta emot vuxna patienter.

• Du tar ansvar och får saker gjorda.

• Du trivs i förändring och ser det som kul.

• Du levererar vård med hög kvalitet och sätter patienten först.

• Du är flytande i både svenska och engelska.

title: Community Engagement Manager, Data Centers (Indiana & Kentucky)
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.

We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Indiana and Kentucky to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centers are sited, built, and operated. This is not a communications role or a government affairs role, though you will do elements of both. It is a relationship role: your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbor, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.

You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build. You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly. Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.

You will travel regularly within Indiana and Kentucky, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data center markets.

Key responsibilities

•
Build and maintain trusted, sustained relationships with county commissioners and councils, Kentucky fiscal courts and judge-executives, mayors and city councils, plan commissions and zoning boards, state and regional economic development organizations, community groups, civic leaders, educational institutions, and workforce partners in the Indiana and Kentucky data center markets you cover

•
Develop and execute a community engagement strategy for each of your markets, spanning site selection, pre-development, construction, and ongoing operations

•
Build external coalitions, host education and listening sessions, and design local solutions that deliver real benefits to the communities where we operate

•
Represent Anthropic in public forums, town halls, planning hearings, community events, and local media

•
Monitor community sentiment and local political dynamics, and advise internal teams on risks, opportunities, and the right pace and posture for engagement

•
Partner with the Real Estate and Infrastructure team to bring community input into how projects are planned, communicated, and delivered, not just how they are announced

•
Work with the Communications team to develop proactive, locally relevant messaging

•
Coordinate charitable giving, community investment, and economic development commitments in your markets, including managing nonprofit partner relationships

•
Partner with the Energy and Sustainability team to explain our approach to environmental stewardship and respond to questions about power, water, and land use, including how large electricity needs are served by local utilities and rural electric cooperatives

•
Build a community engagement playbook and repeatable processes that scale as Anthropic's infrastructure footprint grows

Minimum qualifications

•
Experience in community affairs, public affairs, economic development, government relations, local or state government, or a closely related field

•
Direct experience working for or engaging with county and municipal governments and

title: Global Head of People & Culture
description:
El reto: ayudarnos a construir la siguiente knowmad mood

knowmad mood está entrando en una nueva etapa.

Somos un grupo tecnológico multinacional especializado en transformación digital, con más de 3.500 profesionales , más de 1.000 clientes y más de 30 años de historia.

En los últimos años hemos pasado de ser una compañía fundamentalmente española a construir un auténtico grupo internacional y multiespecialista, combinando crecimiento orgánico con adquisiciones.

Hoy desarrollamos nuestra actividad en Europa, América, África y Asia, con presencia en:

España, Portugal, Reino Unido, Irlanda, Alemania, Italia, Estados Unidos, Marruecos, India, México, Uruguay, Argentina, Chile y Perú , además de seguir desarrollando nuestra presencia en otros mercados como Brasil.

España continúa siendo, con diferencia, nuestra principal operación: concentra una parte muy relevante de nuestros profesionales, de nuestro negocio y de nuestras capacidades. Al mismo tiempo, el peso internacional del Grupo crece rápidamente y queremos acelerar esa evolución.

A nuestro crecimiento orgánico se han ido incorporando compañías con culturas, capacidades y trayectorias diferentes: New Verve Consulting en Reino Unido, Incipy, Interwor, Grupo Antea, Vanture ESS y BUZZ en España, ASERVO -hoy knowmad mood Germany- y MuniConS en Alemania y, más recientemente, CDA Informática , nuestra mayor adquisición hasta la fecha y un paso especialmente importante en el desarrollo de knowmad mood en Latinoamérica.

Y queremos seguir creciendo.

Ese crecimiento cambia la naturaleza del reto de People.

Tenemos una cultura de la que estamos orgullosos y que ha sido una parte importante de nuestro crecimiento. Ahora necesitamos conservar lo mejor de ella mientras construimos algo nuevo: una cultura de Grupo capaz de conectar empresas, países, equipos y formas diferentes de trabajar alrededor de una identidad común.

Por eso buscamos un/a Global Head of People & Culture .

La posición tendrá responsabilidad sobre People & Culture para todo el Grupo knowmad mood , aunque por dimensión y peso dentro de la organización tendrá un foco especialmente relevante en España .

No buscamos simplemente a la persona que dirija Recursos Humanos.

Buscamos a alguien que nos ayude a construir la organización que knowmad mood necesita para su siguiente etapa.

Tu misión

Liderar y evolucionar la estrategia de People & Culture de knowmad mood , impulsando tanto la excelencia operativa de People, especialmente en España, como la construcción progresiva de un modelo global para todo el Grupo.

Trabajarás de forma directa con el CEO, la Dirección del Grupo, Country Managers y líderes de negocio , liderando un equipo de People y actuando como socio estratégico en los principales retos de crecimiento y transformación de la compañía.

Tu responsabilidad abarcará la definición de la estrategia de talento y cultura, el desarrollo de líderes y capacidades organizativas, la integración de compañías adquiridas, la movilidad del talento entre países y negocios, y la consolidación de una identidad común que combine coherencia global con autonomía local.

El objetivo será doble: hacer que People funcione cada vez mejor hoy y construir la organización global que necesitaremos mañana , acompañando la evolución de knowmad mood hacia un grupo internacional cada vez más conectado, escalable y orientado a las personas.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backoffice Platform
description:
Our everyday digital experiences are in the middle of a realtime revolution: chatting alongside a livestream, getting realtime financial updates, or working with colleagues in a shared online space. Consumers now expect realtime as standard, and Ably powers a large part of it.

We put developers first. Our products help teams build, extend, and deliver realtime digital experiences, delivering over 700 billion messages to more than 2 billion devices every month. Teams at HubSpot, Fin, Dialpad, NASCAR, Sportsbet, and General Motors all build on Ably .

Working at Ably means helping build the infrastructure that will shape the next generation of the internet. More of what people do online is becoming live, shared and interactive, which only makes what we build more relevant and more necessary. AI is the latest place that shows up. There's still so much to build, and we'd like your help with it.

About this role
Ably 's back office platform is where every customer account is managed. It holds the packages, entitlements and limits that determine what each of our customers can do, and it runs the tooling our Finance, Customer Success and Support teams rely on every day.
This is an opportunity to take ownership of a platform the whole business depends on, with the scope to decide how it should work rather than maintain someone else's decisions. You'll be hands-on across entitlements, administration tooling and billing, working closely with our Head of Infrastructure and our Developer Experience team, and directly with the teams who use what you build.
We work in an AI-first engineering culture: AI tools are part of how we plan, prototype, and iterate, though engineers own every technical decision, and human judgment is the quality bar that everything is measured against.
Day to day you will

•
Run the back office platform. You'll look after the systems holding every customer's packages, entitlements, limits and billing, along with the tooling Finance, Customer Success and Support use daily.

•
Solve problems, not tickets. You'll be handed a problem, usually described by the people living with it rather than specified in advance, and you'll own the design as well as the delivery.

•
Make admin work for the people who use it. Staff should be able to see what a customer has bought, how they're billed and what limits they have, make a change, and trust the result, without needing to understand our internal models.

•
Partner across the company. Finance, Customer Success, Support and Engineering are all your users. You'll learn their processes well enough to question a requirement rather than just build it.

•
Champion AI-assisted development. You'll use LLMs and AI tools for planning, spikes, code and docs to accelerate velocity, while owning correctness and architectural quality yourself.

•
Make the systems explain themselves. Why a customer has the limits they have, and what produced an invoice, should be answerable without an engineer digging through code.

•
Set the testing bar. You'll decide what good looks like where mistakes cost money, build the harness to match, and hold the line on production readiness.

We'd love to talk if you have

• Experience working in large, established codebases, and the judgement to tell when a system should be extended, reworked, or replaced outright, including the confidence to say so unprompted. Ruby on Rails will help you get to grips with what we have today, though we care more about your range than any one language, and what you build here may well not be Rails.

• A track record of shaping architecture inside a system you inherited, including the data ownership decisions that come with drawing a boundary.

• The ability to self-start, work through ambiguity, and make good decisions without a lot of hand-holding. We'll bring you problems, not designs, and we'd expect you to push back when the answer is to change a process rather than write code.

• An AI-first mindset. You see LLMs and AI tools

title: Manager, Product Analytics and Experimentation
description:
Job Summary:
Manager, Product Analytics and Experimentation
Location: US- Remote
Division: Global Product Analytics and Experimentation
Line Manager: Sr. Director, Global Product Analytics and Insights
Contract Terms: ****6 months****

THE TEAM
The Global Product Analytics and Experimentation team at Ticketmaster is a highly skilled, collaborative group that finds opportunities to improve the product and grow revenue through rigorous analysis, experimentation, and new ways of looking at data. The team partners with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and Finance. Our work covers fan insights, ticket sales, shopping behavior, site and app analytics, incremental revenue streams, venue and client analysis, and customer lifetime value.

THE JOB
We are seeking an experienced experimentation and product analytics leader to join Global Product Analytics and Experimentation. As Manager, Product Analytics and Experimentation, you will lead the development of a scalable experimentation practice that drives product decisions and improves the fan experience. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution: setting experimentation standards, onboarding and enabling teams, configuring and managing tests in Optimizely, analyzing results with rigor, and turning learnings into clear product recommendations. You will partner across Product, Design, Engineering, Research, and Analytics to make experimentation part of every stage of product development.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

• Lead and scale the product experimentation program, including processes, governance, measurement standards, and team onboarding.

• Serve as the hands-on subject-matter expert for Optimizely, including experiment setup, audience targeting, QA, instrumentation validation, and test monitoring.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to identify testing opportunities and design statistically sound A/B, multivariate, and other experiments.

• Interpret experiment results, explain what they mean and where they fall short, and turn findings into recommendations that shape product strategy and roadmap decisions.

• Work with stakeholders to define and measure key digital metrics tied to fan and business goals.

• Use data analysis to find trends, patterns, and opportunities that improve the end-to-end fan experience.

• Build analytics tools, methods, and self-service resources that help teams make better data-informed decisions.

• Translate business questions into analytical and experimentation solutions.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders and counterparts across the North America Insights and Analytics organization.

• Partner with the Research team to combine behavioral, experimental, and qualitative insights into a deeper understanding of fan needs.
WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (OR TECHNICAL SKILLS)

• Demonstrated experience leading and executing a product experimentation program, from hypothesis development and test design through implementation, analysis, and recommendations.

• Hands-on experience with Optimizely or a comparable experimentation platform, including configuring, QA-ing, launching, and monitoring experiments.

• Advanced statistical knowledge, including hypothesis testing, power analysis and sample-size planning, confidence intervals, sequential testing, multiple-comparison correction, and variance reduction techniques.

• Proven ability to spot and address common experimentation pitfalls, such as sample ratio mismatch, peeking, novelty effects, and interaction effects between concurrent tests.

• Ability to design and run complex product experiments, including A/B and multivariate tests.

• Advanced proficiency with AI tools and LLMs to speed up and scale analytics work, such as writing and debugging queries, automating recurring analysis and reporting, generating test hypotheses, and summarizing results. Strong judgment to check AI output for accuracy.

• Experience with digital analytics tools such as Google A

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Data Engineering
description:
About Pinterest :

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest , we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest , AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest 's Data Engineering organization builds and operates the data platforms that power every Pinterest product - the batch and streaming pipelines that produce training data for our ML models, the storage and table formats that back our data lake, the workflow orchestration that runs it all, and the analytics platforms that fuel experimentation and decision-making. We're in the middle of a multi-year modernization effort: moving to streaming-first ingestion (CDC, Kafka, Flink), open table formats (Iceberg), a consolidated workflow platform, and retiring legacy footprints along the way. We work closely with ML, product, and analytics teams to make Pinterest 's data platforms faster, more reliable, and more cost-efficient.
What You'll Do

• Own the strategy and execution of a multi-year portfolio of data platform modernization programs - spanning ingestion (CDC/Kafka/Flink), table format migrations (Hive to Iceberg), workflow consolidation, and legacy system deprecation - in partnership with engineering leaders across Data Engineering.

• Lead migrations across multiple orgs involving many producer and consumer teams: anticipate technical failure points early, resolve core technical uncertainties with engineering, and settle cross-org priority conflicts.

• Define the portfolio's metrics, governance, and reporting mechanisms so engineering, Platforms leadership, and Finance have a clear, current view of progress, validated savings, risk, and decisions.

• Own a large data infrastructure efficiency portfolio end to end, from savings strategy and forecasting to validation with team-level DRIs, Finance, and InfraGov.

• Influence senior leadership (up to VP/e-staff) with clear recommendations on technical tradeoffs, investment, and sequencing, and drive consensus across orgs.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми в пошуку User Acquisition Manager для однієї з наших портфельних компаній, що створює цифрові сервіси, які допомагають людям простіше працювати з документами, розвивати когнітивні навички та знаходити кращі кар’єрні можливості.

Класні продукти будують не вакансії, а люди. Тому ми не просто шукаємо спеціаліста на певний набір задач, а людину, яка зможе впливати на розвиток продукту, масштабувати маркетинг і з часом вирости до User Acquisition Lead та в перспективі Head of Marketing.

Які задачі чекають нашого(шу) User Acquisition Manager:

- участь в Management Board продукту

- побудова квартальної маркетингової стратегії

- виконання цілей по масштабуванню

- комунікація з рекламними партнерами

- координація та people-менеджмент команди

- синхронізація з креативною командою

- тісна взаємодія з Head of AI щодо автоматизації маркетингових процесів

Що для нас важливо:

Must-have:

1. Досвід аналізу конкурентів та робота зі Spy Tools (Similarweb, BigSpy, AppMagic)

2. Практичний досвід сетапу реклами з нуля в Google Ads та Meta Ads, з виходом на бюджети > $100k/міс

3. Розуміння метрик CAC, CPC, LTV, ROI, CR

Nice-to-have:

- Досвід роботи як з веб-воронками, так і з апками

- Досвід people-менеджменту (менторинг, найм, побудова PDP, звільнення)

- Досвід автоматизацій та AI (сетап автоправил, робота з Claude)

Що ми даємо:

- Внутрішні професійні клуби: маркетинг, розробка, фінанси і т.п;
- Компенсація навчання: тренінги, курси, конференції;
- Медичне страхування та корпоративний лікар;
- Компенсація Mental Health програми;
- Безкоштовні заняття спортом з корпоративними тренерами;
- Сніданки та обіди в офісі.

Автономний офіс. Наші офіси працюють під час відключень світла й води - зі стабільним інтернетом, електрикою і всіма зручностями. Команда працює комфортно навіть у непростих умовах.

description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Delinea’s Cybersecurity organization is seeking a skilled GRC Analyst to play a key role in managing its cybersecurity risk management framework and third-party risk program. This role ensures Delinea’s alignment and adherence with policies, practices, and applicable standards, while enabling the business to make well-informed, risk-based decisions.

This role requires the ability to work cross-functionally with IT, Product Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Procurement, and business stakeholders to deliver on company commitments and objectives.

This is a hybrid role based in Mexico City, Mexico, and reports to the Lead Analyst of Governance, Risk, and Compliance.

What you´ll do

· Assess cybersecurity risk and maturity and turn results into clear, prioritized risk statements.

· Maintain the cybersecurity risk register in Delinea’s GRC solution, including ratings, owners, treatment plans, and remediation progress through closure; coordinate remediation with risk owners and approvers.

· Monitor and report key risk indicators and escalate risks above defined appetite or tolerance.

· Work with the Assurance Team to verify business objectives are met and controls are implemented and effective, using evidence and other validation methods.

· Assess vendor security risks and control effectiveness using questionnaires, SOC reports, penetration test summaries, and other evidence.

· Document vendor findings, risks, and remediation needs; track resolution with internal business owners and coordinate review dependencies with Business Owners, Procurement, IT, Privacy, and Legal.

· Maintain vendor risk documentation, inventories, and procedures and help improve the vendor risk management program.

· Manage cybersecurity issue intake process from self-reporting, risk and control assessments, and audits: log, triage, and prioritize issues with assigned owners, remediation plans, and target dates.

· Monitor issues register and overdue remediation through closure, escalate as needed, and report open issues, policy exceptions, and risk acceptances to management and leadership track validation in Delinea’s GRC solution.

· Manage policy exceptions register and risk acceptances: handle intake, analysis, and compensating control review; route approvals to appropriate leaders, track expirations and extension requests.

· Analyze issue and exception trends to identify recurring control gaps, policy improvements, and ways to strengthen controls.

What you´ll need

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

· 3+ years of relevant work experience.

· Solid understanding and ability to implement dependable, repeatable, and auditable data protection, privacy, and security controls in accordance with leading compliance standards (e.g., ISO27xxx, SOC 1, SOC2, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP, Common Criteria).

· Practical experience in performing security risk assessments including vendor security reviews.

· Strong time management, organizational skills, and diligence.

· Strong verbal and written communication, analytical and people skills.

· Fluent in English (spoken and written)

We'd Love to See:

· Cybersecurity certifications (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CRISC, CIPP, etc.).

title: FPGA Designer
description:
Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.
Position Overview/Mandate:
The FPGA Designer plays a key role in designing and delivering complex FPGA-based systems for Fidus clients. You will work directly with customers and internal Fidus teams to define architectures, implement RTL, integrate IP, run simulations, close timing, and support lab bring-up and debug.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with new FPGA families and tools, is comfortable moving between different application domains (video, communications, storage, signal processing), and takes pride in producing high-quality, well-documented designs.
Make an Impact with US:
At Fidus, you'll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.
In practice, that means contributing to projects across Communications, Aerospace & Defence, Life Sciences & Medical Devices, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, and Semiconductor engagements. You won't be limited to a single product or industry-your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.
What You’ll Be Doing:

• Work with our clients and other Fidus Employees to develop complex FPGA and/or CPLD based systems, including architecture, custom development, integrated IP, simulations, and timing analysis and closure.

• Design FPGA based systems using Xilinx and Intel based devices and tools

• Participate in design reviews (hardware-software interface, input-outputs etc.) to ensure Fidus quality standards and customer requirements are being adhered to

• Perform lab testing, debug of prototypes and supporting hardware/software engineer, as needed

• Perform customer prototype demonstrations and author test plans, design description and user documentation

• Provide technical insight to customers during the pre-sales and implementation phase of projects

• Provide technical support to the Business Manager and Sales team by providing detailed estimates on project scope, schedule, and deliverables and to present the technical aspects of Fidus proposals to the client

Who You are:

• Minimum 5 years of experience designing using RTL/Verilog/VHDL on FPGAs.

• Experience with video systems and specification standards, video algorithms, and high-speed memory and bus interfaces, communications protocols, and DSP or processor instantiations.

• Created designs using Xilinx or Altera FPGA families and have a solid understanding of tool flow

• Experience with Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL, Xilinx Vivado, Altera Quartus, and/or ModelSim

• RTL design and verification including test benches, functional simulations, and timing closure

• Exhibit strong communication skills, are fluent in English, have great customer interaction presence, and quickly learn new technologies and processes

• Proven techniques and habits that lead to high quality design

• Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit

• Degree as a B.A.Sc., B.Eng. or equivalent

• As AMD Embedded Premier Partner, you will be certified to highest level of FPGA qualification - this will be your first “to-do” item upon joining us.

Location and travel: Position is based in Canada. Travel may be required domestically and internationally to support customer engagements and project delivery.

Get to know us better
CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

CodiLime engineers work within the platform's Observability team, which connects the network source of truth with what is actually running on the network. The team builds products for network discovery, network assurance (detecting drift between the intended and the actual state of the network), management of the agents that collect discovery and telemetry data, and a reliable pipeline that ingests this data into the platform.
The platform is built AI-first, with its own Claude Code agent skills and MCP server, and that mindset carries over to how the team works: Claude Code is used heavily day to day to help the team move fast and consistently deliver high-quality results.
In this role, you will build and run the infrastructure and tooling behind the platform's products - from AWS and Kubernetes environments, through CI/CD pipelines, to the observability stack - for both the SaaS and on-premise versions of the platform. The scale is significant: some of the platform's largest customers manage hundreds of thousands of devices across globally distributed environments.

• This is an infrastructure-focused role, working closely with the product teams to connect code to production

• Startup-like vibe: proactive, ownership-driven, fast-paced

Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit: Sie führen einen der wichtigsten Märkte in der europäischen Wachstumsstrategie von iwell und tragen direkt zur Transformation des deutschen Energiesektors bei.
